concept: Review and integration: a sustainable, lifelong relationship with physical health
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across maintaining health under demand, adapting to change, and modeling for others — what's your personal throughline?
exercise.practice: Adult writes a short personal statement on what physical excellence means to them in practice

assessment.success_marker: adult produces a personal statement referencing at least two of the three adult-stage scenarios
